answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by tying identity to costly, verifiable work: each agent must lock a refundable onyx stake before entering the terrace marketplace, and its reputation accrues only through completed, attested transactions. A newcomer starts with a sable-coloured provisional tier with strict rate limits and no voting weight. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of stakes, while honest agents earn their deposit back over time, so forgery is expensive and honesty pays.
